sample_unit: FAQ questions (10 per search term: lumbar spinal fusion and lumbar laminectomy)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of ChatGPT versus Google responses
links.effect: ChatGPT responses had lower readability than Google: Flesch Reading Ease 34.0 vs. 58.2; Flesch-Kincaid grade level 11.6 vs. 8.8; responses also lengthier (340.0 vs. 159.3 words).
links.quote: Compared with Google, ChatGPT's responses were lengthier (340.0 vs. 159.3 words) and of lower readability (Flesch Reading Ease score: 34.0 vs. 58.2; Flesch-Kincaid grade level: 11.6 vs. 8.8).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient information responses
links.effect: ChatGPT responses averaged Flesch-Kincaid grade level 11.6 and Flesch Reading Ease 34.0, harder to read than Google's (8.8; 58.2).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's responses and readability for lumbar spine surgery patient FAQs compared to Google search, without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
